character.description: The same young adult woman anime protagonist in every shot: long black hair adorned with a narrow gold-and-lapis band, kohl-dark eyes with warm gold flecks, with a recognizable consistent face and adult body proportions. They are a temple astronomer recording the stars above the Nile. Fixed costume: a white linen dress with lapis-blue collar, gold cuffs, and flat leather sandals. Signature tool or keepsake: a small lapis scarab seal. Maintain the exact same face, hairstyle, hair color, eye color, proportions, costume silhouette, and signature object across the complete music video.
consistency_rules: One clearly defined protagonist leads this theme from beginning to end.
Keep the same face, hairstyle, hair color, eye color, adult age impression, and body proportions in every scene.
Preserve the signature outfit, its color identity, and the defining tool or keepsake.
Do not redesign, replace, or multiply the lead character unless the lyrics explicitly require another person.
